title: Maestro's record (maestro.log) keeps the real inputText value in plain text
symptom: ~/.maestro/tests/<timestamp>/maestro.log contains InputTextCommand(text=<real value>), even though it was passed as an environment variable (${...})
cause: maestro test records each command with environment variables expanded (evaluatedCommand). The default record location is ~/.maestro/tests, so it stays after the run ends (measured on Maestro 2.10.0)
fix: pro-launch's app type and type steps send the record to a temp folder (--debug-output <temp folder> --flatten-debug-output) and delete it; use the same options when you call maestro test yourself
If records already remain, tell the user and ask whether to delete them (do not delete them on your own)
